title: Introduce probationary failover inspector and transient SLO sanitizer (hotfix)
author: Sofia Patel
release_notes: Hotfix: adds probationary failover inspector that quarantines repeat SLO offenders into transient fallback paths; fixes stale circuit state after control-plane leader failover; adds telemetry and dashboard. Rolling canary and rollback documented.
description:
Context and motivation: We observed multiple incidents where tenants with repeated short-lived SLO breaches triggered noisy regional failovers and caused oscillation in the circuit-manager. This PR introduces a probationary failover inspector (PFI) that: 1) detects tenant SLO drift patterns across short windows, 2) places qualifying tenants into a probationary fallback lane (reduced concurrency + fallback model variant) for a configurable probation TTL, and 3) marks and isolates their circuit state in a transient regional quarantine to avoid cascade reopens during leader failovers. The change mitigates oscillation by avoiding full tenant eviction or immediate hard failover while preserving higher-priority tenants' SLOs. This is a hotfix with a conservative rollout.

What this PR does (single-string): Adds a new controlplane component services/slo/inspector.go that runs lightweight windowed SLO heuristics and emits probation decisions; extends controlplane/failover/quarantine.go to create transient quarantine objects tied to tenant epoch; introduces an idempotent stale-circuit-reset path to recover circuits left in an OPEN_PENDING state after control-plane leader handoff; surfaces probation telemetry to console/telemetry/dashboard.yaml and adds integration tests under tests/slo/probation_integration_test.go. Includes feature-flag guarded runtime knobs: feature.flags.slo_probation.enabled (off by default), probation.ttl.seconds (default 300), probation.max_concurrency_ratio (default 0.25). The PR is implemented to be opt-in and non-breaking.

Checklist (for reviewers and release): [x] Unit tests for inspector heuristics and probation TTL [x] Integration test that simulates leader failover and verifies stale-circuit-reset [x] Telemetry instrumentation and dashboard panel [x] Canary rollout plan documented below [ ] Post-rollout watch runbook (to be merged to ops) 

Canary + rollout plan (in description): 1) Deploy to staging and run integration test harness (automated). 2) Canary to 2% of production tenant traffic in one region for 30 minutes with slo_probation.enabled=true and telemetry sampling=100%. 3) If no regression (error spike or latency SLO drop) escalate canary to 25% over 2 hours. 4) After 6 hours of stable metrics, roll to 100% globally. Rollback: toggle slo_probation.enabled=false or set probation.ttl.seconds=0 to immediately drain probation lanes. During rollout watch for increased 5xxs, slowpath saturation, or spikes in circuit transitions.

Operational notes: probation decisions are emitted as controlplane.events.probation_decision with tenant_id, window_ms, violation_count, and action. Quarantine objects are soft-state and include origin_leader_id to aid postmortem. The stale-circuit-reset path is conservative: it only resets circuits that are OPEN_PENDING and whose last heartbeat is older than controlplane.leader_handoff_grace_ms (default 60s). The reset is gated by a leader-signed token to avoid multiple nodes racing to clear the same circuit.

Why this is different from previous changes: Rather than immediately evicting or hard-tripping tenants, the PFI offers a probation lane that limits tenant resource usage and isolates circuit transitions, reducing oscillations during transient load spikes or control-plane churn. It purposely avoids long-lived tenant quarantines and keeps all changes behind a feature flag.

small_snippets: inspector heuristic (pseudocode): if violations_in_window >= threshold && !recent_probation -> emit probation_decision(tenant, ttl)
quarantine creation: Quarantine{tenant_id, origin_leader_id, expires_at} // soft-state, GC'd after expires_at
stale-circuit-reset guard: if circuit.state == OPEN_PENDING && now - last_heartbeat > grace_ms && leader_token.valid -> reset(circuit)
review_comments: Markus Chen: Requested change - make probation.max_concurrency_ratio configurable per-tenant via tenant profile. Also prefer a separate metrics name for probation_count vs probation_activations.

Sofia Patel: Reply - agreed on per-tenant override. Implemented tenant.profile.slo_probation.max_ratio with fallback to global flag. Split metrics into probation_count and probation_activations. See commit b8d3302 and d4b21aa.

Jared Liu: Comment - please add an integration scenario that simulates control-plane leader handoff during a high-violation burst to validate stale-circuit-reset. Also check for race on token issuance.
Sofia Patel: Reply - added leader-failover scenario in tests/slo/probation_integration_test.go and tightened token issuance path; added leader signed token validation. See commit f32e9b1.
Aisha Romero: Approve - telemetry looks sufficient and rollout plan is reasonable. Approving for hotfix canary.
Markus Chen: Approve and merged - small nit about log verbosity fixed in follow-up commit.
